allow: Bash(ls -la ~/.ssh/*.pub 2>/dev/null && echo "--- mevcut anahtar var ---" || echo "Henüz SSH anahtarı yok.")
Bash(GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new" git push origin master)
Bash(echo "remote geri alındı: $\(git remote get-url origin\)")
Bash(echo "local helper: $\(git config --local --get credential.helper || echo yok\)")
Bash(echo "global helper: $\(git config --global --get credential.helper || echo yok\)")
Bash(echo "system helper: $\(git config --system --get credential.helper 2>/dev/null || echo yok\)")
